(2) Digital news article overlays appear over the man, showing Traditional Chinese text headlines about the Russia-Ukraine war and Trump's peace plan. The man remains visible in the center, though partially covered by the white and blue news interfaces. (3) The man continues speaking, now using more expansive hand gestures. The camera angle is a medium shot at eye-level. Yellow question marks and text overlays like '24小時內' and '28點' appear momentarily to highlight key points. (4) More news screenshots from '公視新聞網' and other outlets are displayed, showing updated peace plan details. The man transitions between nodding and using analytical hand movements. The environment remains consistent with the professional studio setting. (5) Three large yellow graphic cards appear sequentially, posing questions in Traditional Chinese. The man is still in the background but the graphics dominate the frame. The footer slogan remains at the bottom of the screen throughout.
